Class ReflectionFeedbackService

java.lang.Object
com.example.personalityquest.Services.chat.ReflectionFeedbackService
public final class ReflectionFeedbackService extends Object
Builds a coaching prompt from a weekly-task reflection and asks OpenAI for feedback.
